findings.detail: The cited PrimeFlight duplicate-key example is two valid same-issuer term-loan positions distinguished by rate, floor, par, cost, and fair value.

rationale: B02 flagged duplicate position keys, with PrimeFlight as the example. Raw SOI source shows PrimeFlight has two adjacent term-loan line items under the same issuer and maturity, but they are distinct positions: row 26 is S+525 with a 0.00% floor, par 9,950, cost 9,851, fair value 9,950; row 27 is S+475 with a 1.00% floor, par 4,988, cost 4,938, fair value 4,938. The Air Freight & Logistics subtotal includes both rows, so collapsing them as duplicate keys is an over-coarse rule/keying issue rather than a data error.
